svg.title: CEA-List · VR assembly training (Mar 2026 – Aug 2026)
svg.desc: CEA-List, Mar 2026 to Aug 2026: Unreal Engine 5 C++ visual guides for a VR industrial-assembly training application on the XDE physics engine. Proprietary code, case study on the portfolio.
svg.text: R&D engineering intern · Interactive Simulation Laboratory (LSI), Palaiseau
Unreal Engine 5 C++ visual guides for a VR industrial-assembly training app on the XDE
physics engine: part ghosts replay each mechanical joint's degrees of freedom.
Visual aids, VR interaction and module documentation shipped to the lab.
